releaseNotes: Made the repository agent-installable end to end: `npm run setup` at the root installs the engine package and runs formation setup, which now prints the MCP registration for all three agent runtimes the engine dispatches — the claude mcp add command, the ~/.cursor/mcp.json entry, and the ~/.codex/config.toml block — each with this checkout's real server path filled in, plus the optional npm link for a global formation command. The root README quickstart is the recipient's journey (clone, npm ci, npm run setup, five commands to a scheduled business) and includes the paste-to-your-agent handoff paragraph; nothing in it names an internal tsx path anymore.

Proven on a genuinely fresh clone, not the maintainer checkout: clone -> npm ci -> npm run setup (all three registrations printed) -> formation new -> bootstrap --apply -> workspaces register -> plan (87 steps, 6 ready) -> list, under a throwaway FORMATION_HOME. bootstrap's own success message now points at formation run and the registry step instead of the internal tsx invocation, and the cli fixture pins the three-runtime registration output so setup cannot silently drop one.
